findings.action: fix: a read must advance the cursor
findings.note: The parameter is an address, never a parse stream: the only method invoked on it is isSliceBitsEqual, which compares bits and cannot advance a cursor. LEP's own doc comment states the contract as "receives a slice parameter, reads from it", and every one of its tests reads with loadUint — but `usage` marks the parameter used on any mention of the name. Demanding assertEnd after a comparison is meaningless. Wrong answer on production code, so a bug rather than a boundary.

ctxBody is a real message body: routeInternal loads the opcode and the query id from it and every branch returns without asserting the end, so trailing data a caller attaches is silently ignored. True by the detector's own contract. Exploitability is NOT established — the body is never rehashed or forwarded whole — and nothing is reported to the programme on this basis.

Every op branch of routeInternal opens with a constraint on ctxSender, written either as requireX(ctxSender, ...) or as ctxSender.isSliceBitsEqual(...) with a throw on mismatch. AC sees only the entrypoint body and one delegation hop by bare name. The one branch that mutates nothing and guards nothing, tgusd-staking OP_PROVIDE_CURRENT_QUOTE, is a public quote endpoint by design: it assigns no storage field and forwards the caller's own value. Fifth through eighth confirmation of a class already past its threshold.

Fifth through eighth confirmation of a class already past its threshold.

findings.action: fix: a read must advance the cursor
findings.note: The parameter is an address, never a parse stream: the only method invoked on it is isSliceBitsEqual, which compares bits and cannot advance a cursor. LEP's own doc comment states the contract as "receives a slice parameter, reads from it", and every one of its tests reads with loadUint — but `usage` marks the parameter used on any mention of the name. Demanding assertEnd after a comparison is meaningless. Wrong answer on production code, so a bug rather than a boundary.
